newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia's tourism income $1.17 bln in 10 months.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia's tourism income $1.17 bln in 10 months.

text.p: Tunisia's tourism income, its main source of hard currency, rose seven percent in the first ten months of 1996 compared with the same period the previous year, Tourism Ministry sources said on Wednesday.
The sources said the income climbed to 1.147 billion dinars ($1.17 billion) to October 20 this year from 1.072 billion dinars a year earlier.
Number of tourists dropped 4.6 percent to 3.04 million at the end of September 1996 from 3.19 million the previous year.
Tourists from European countries rose 6.3 percent to 1.96 million from 1.85 million while those from Maghreb countries, mainly Algeria and Libya, fell 22 percent.
Tunisia expects 1.4 billion dinars income from tourism in 1996, slightly up from 1.32 billion in 1995, Tourism and Handicrafts Minister Slaheddine Maaoui said last month.
